arguments.command:
git stash && python -c "
import toolz
from toolz.curried.exceptions import merge, merge_with
from importlib import import_module

exceptions = import_module('toolz.curried.exceptions')

def should_curry(func):
    if not callable(func) or isinstance(func, toolz.curry):
        return False
    nargs = toolz.functoolz.num_required_args(func)
    if nargs is None or nargs > 1:
        return True
    return nargs == 1 and toolz.functoolz.has_keywords(func)

def curry_namespace(ns):
    return {
        name: toolz.curry(f) if should_curry(f) else f
        for name, f in ns.items() if '__' not in name
    }

from_toolz = curry_namespace(vars(toolz))
from_exceptions = curry_namespace(vars(exceptions))

print('accumulate should_curry:', should_curry(toolz.accumulate))
print('accumulate is same object?', from_toolz['accumulate'] is toolz.curried.accumulate)
print('accumulate eq?', from_toolz['accumulate'] == toolz.curried.accumulate)
print('type from_toolz[acc]:', type(from_toolz['accumulate']))
print('type curried[acc]:', type(toolz.curried.accumulate))
" && git stash pop
